premises.text: Eye disease is often painless until too late, so prevention requires regular retinal screening especially for growing diabetic risk groups that outpace ophthalmologist capacity
premises.evidence_span: The only way to achieve it is to do regular screening. And they do it for the risk groups of patients. But still, the problem is too big. For example, the biggest risk group is diabetic patients

premises.text: An AI assistant diagnoses retinal disease from fundus images via convolutional neural networks in about a minute at above-human accuracy
premises.evidence_span: we've built our artificial intelligence assistant that can help doctor to make diagnosis just in a couple of seconds

premises.text: Workflow is drag-and-drop of an existing photo after capture at GP/optometrist, replacing slow specialist review latency
premises.evidence_span: you still have to go to take your picture. But then you just drag and drop the photo. Convolutional neural networks do all of the job, and you receive your diagnosis within one minute

premises.text: First customers are optician chains, GPs, and telemedicine companies on a per-image subscription priced below current Dutch screening fees
premises.evidence_span: We see our first customers as optician chains, general practitioners, and telemedicine companies, as they are the first line of eye care today. We're going to propose them our subscription model based on how much images they use monthly, starting with only five euros per image

premises.text: Few global AI ophthalmology competitors exist and Deep-D is the only European player at this stage
premises.evidence_span: There are three companies in US, one in China, and we're the only one at this stage in Europe

premises.text: Partnership with EyeClinic Rotterdam will collect and annotate specialized images to build the first AI glaucoma screening solution and validate it as a new ophthalmology standard
premises.evidence_span: we're going to collect and annotate together with them more than 100,000 specialized images for glaucoma screening. And it will be the first glaucoma screening solution in the world

premises.text: After validation, plan is Dutch market entry then US expansion with regulatory approval
premises.evidence_span: we're going to penetrate Dutch market in the end of this year. And by 2020, we're going to receive our FDI approval and move to US market

premises.text: Longer term, retinal imaging can reveal cardiovascular and neurological disease and smartphone cameras may enable consumer retinoscopy
premises.evidence_span: it gives us opportunity to discover cardiovascular diseases and neurological diseases also. So it's like a window into human's health

value.text: Help doctors prevent vision loss by screening and diagnosing eye disease before it is too late
value.evidence_span: We don't want to treat patients when it's that bad. We want to prevent it

secondary_value.text: Lower cost and faster screening for first-line eye-care providers
secondary_value.evidence_span: starting with only five euros per image, comparing to the lowest price on Dutch market today is 25 euros per screening
